original: You've gained a taste... for human blood! When you're in Sneak mode, you gain the option to drink blood from a corpse to regain Health and restore dehydration and sleep deprivation equal to the sum of your Endurance and Agility. But every time you drink blood, you will you lose a small amount of Karma and suffer radiation damage.
translation: 你食髓知味地品尝...人血！当处于潜行模式，你可以选择从尸体中饮血来恢复生命，并恢复相当于你耐力与敏捷之和的口渴和睡眠。但是每次饮血，你都会损失少量的道德值遭受辐射伤害。

original: Something about your presence dampens others' desires to exceed. Your enemy's chance of getting critical hits on you is multiplied by x0.9 for each point your Charisma is below 10.
translation: 你的现身令他人的念想彻底幻灭。你的魅力每比10低一点，敌人对你造成暴击的几率就会乘以0.1。

original: You don't take kindly to raiders, junkies, or tribals trying to "settle" or "stay alive" in civilized lands. Against dirty raider, slaver and junkie types, as well as tribals, you do +15% damage and have a bonus to hit in V.A.T.S. (Requires Evil Karma).
translation: 你对那些想要“定居”或“活在”文明之地的掠夺者、瘾君子和土人可不怎么友好。对肮肮脏的掠夺者、奴隶贩子和瘾君子，以及好不到哪去的土人，你造成+15%伤害并拥有V.A.T.S.下的命中奖励。(需要邪恶道德)

original: You're more at home under the open stars than under a roof. Any time you sleep outside, you gain the benefits of being Well Rested, even if you don't own the bed.
translation: 开阔的星空比能遮风挡雨的屋檐更让你自在。无论何时在户外过夜，你都将获得充分休息的益处，床已经不再是必须品了。

original: Years as the Vault little league MVP have honed your hitting and throwing. With each rank, you gain 10% damage when using bats and nail boards, and you throw grenades 10% harder and farther.
translation: 身为避难所小联盟MVP的日子磨练了你的打击和投掷技能。每一级，你增加10%使用棒球棍和钉板的伤害，并且你投掷手雷的强度和距离增加10%。

original: When you take the Master Trader perk, you gain a 3% discount per 10 points in Speech.
translation: 选择交易大师perk，你每有10点口才就获得3%的折扣。

original: With each rank of the Thief perk, you gain +5 Sneak and +5% pickpocket chance.
translation: 每有一级小偷perk，你都会获得+5潜行和+5%扒窃成功率。

original: With each rank of the Iron Fist perk, you deal +1 Unarmed damage per rank of Endurance.
translation: 铁拳perk每有一级，你的每点耐力就能多造成1点徒手伤害。

original: Just like dear old Dad, you've devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. With each rank, hacking gets easier and you use chems 10% more effectively.
translation: 和亲爱的老爸一样，你专心于脑力工作。每一级，进行骇入的难度和使用化学品的效果都改善10%。

original: You're obsessed with using and maintaining a wide variety of conventional firearms. With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, when using a gun, spread and item condition damage are reduced by 5%.
translation: 你痴迷于使用和保养各种各样的常规枪支。每有一级枪迷perk，你用枪时的散布和物品耐久损耗都降低5%。

original: Take the Scoundrel perk, and you can use your wily charms to influence people. With each rank, vendors give an 8% discount, and you gain extra XP for passing speech checks.
translation: 你的脸皮可能有城墙拐角那么厚。有了厚颜无耻perk，你可以用你厚黑学的艺术来影响他人。每有一级，商人会给予8%的折扣，并且你将通过口才检定获取额外XP。

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any good character you kill will have an ear on their corpse. This ear can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and negative Karma  (Requires Evil Karma).
translation: 有了合同杀手perk，你杀死任何善良角色之后，在尸体上能得到一个耳朵。该耳朵可以出售给指定的角色（在你得到该perk后，角色的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和邪恶道德值。

original: You've made permanent enhancements to your body! The Cyborg perk instantly adds +10% to your Poison, Radiation, Energy and Fire Resistances.
translation: 你的躯体得到了永久性的增强！赛博格perk立即将你的毒素、辐射、能量和火焰抗性增加10%。

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any evil character you kill will have a finger on their corpse. This finger can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and positive Karma (Requires Good Karma).
translation: 有了法律使者perk，你杀死任何邪恶角色之后，在尸体上能得到一根手指。该手指可以出售给指定的角色（在你得到该perk后，角色的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和善良道德值。

original: With the Impartial Mediation trait, you gain +10 points to Speech while you maintain a neutral karma level, but you suffer -1 Charisma and -5 Speech while Good, Very Good, Evil, or Very Evil.
translation: 有了不偏不倚特质，当你的道德值处于中立时获得+10点口才，但处于善良、非常善良、邪恶或非常邪恶时承受-1魅力和-5口才的惩罚。

original: You're obsessed with really big weapons. With each rank of this perk, you gain 10% better accuracy, reload and equip speed when using Big Guns.
translation: 你痴迷于正宗的大型武器。这个perk每有一级，你使用大型枪械时的精度、装填和装备速度改善10%。

original: You've become an expert with the Auto Axe. It's Strength requirement has been reduced by 1, and you deal +15% damage with all automatic melee weapons.
translation: 你成为了使用自动锯的专家。其力量需求已减少1，并且你用所有自动近战武器造成的伤害+15%。

original: When you take the No Weakness perk, all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats that are less than 5 are instantly increased to 5.
translation: 选择毫无破绽perk，你所有尚未达到5的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至5。

original: You are such a Party Boy that you no longer suffer the withdrawal effect from alcohol addiction.
translation: 作为一个派对小子，你已经不会再受到酒精上瘾的负面作用影响了。

original: You are such a Party Girl that you no longer suffer the withdrawal effect from alcohol addiction.
translation: 作为一个派对女孩，你已经不会再受到酒精上瘾的负面作用影响了。

original: Although you are still notified when you get Minor Radiation Poisoning, you do not suffer any ill effects from it.
translation: 尽管你出现轻微辐射感染时仍会收到提示，但你不再受到任何负面效果影响了。

original: With the Puppies! perk, if Dogmeat dies, you'll be able to get a new canine companion from his litter of puppies. Just wait a bit, and you'll find your new furry friend waiting outside Vault 101.
translation: 有了小狗崽perk，如果狗肉死了，你将立刻得到他的小狗崽作为新的伙伴。只要等上一段时间，你就会在101避难所门外找到你全新的毛绒朋友。

original: You sleep deeply no matter where you are. You get the Well Rested benefit no matter what bed you sleep in.
translation: 不管在哪里，你都能睡得很熟。无论睡在哪张床上，你都会获得休息良好的益处。

original: Take the Almost Perfect perk, and all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats are instantly raised to 9.
translation: 有了几近完美perk，你所有尚未达到9点的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至9。

original: With the Nuclear Anomaly perk, whenever your Health is reduced to 20 or less, you will erupt into a devastating nuclear explosion. Note that any allies in the vicinity will also suffer the effects of the blast!
translation: 有了核子异变perk，当你的生命下降至20或者更低时，你的身体将会释放一场毁灭性的核爆。要注意你身边的盟友也会受到波及！

original: When you choose the Devil's Highway perk, your Karma is instantly set to Very Evil.
translation: 选择魔鬼高速路perk，你的道德值将立刻变为非常邪恶。

original: When you choose the Karmic Rebalance perk, your Karma is instantly set to Neutral.
translation: 选择善恶平衡perk，你的道德值将立刻变为中立。

original: When you choose the Escalator to Heaven perk, your Karma is instantly set to Very Good.
translation: 选择天堂直升梯perk，你的道德值将立刻变为非常善良。

original: You have unlocked the secret to creating Nuka-Cola Quantum. With this perk, every ten Nuka-Colas in your inventory can be crafted into a Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 你解锁了制造核子可乐量子版的秘方。有了这个 perk，你能用库存中的10瓶核子可乐创造1瓶核子可乐量子版。

original: With the Staunch Defender Perk, you gain +5 DT while standing still in combat.
translation: 有了拦路的强敌perk，你在战斗中站立不动时+5 DT。

original: Knock em right outta the park! Your attack speed with two handed melee weapons is increased by 8%, and you do an additional 7 points of damage while using any baseball bat.
translation: 把他们打出球场！你使用双手近战武器时的攻击速度提升8%，并且你用任何棒球棍时造成额外的7点伤害。

original: Protect what's important.  With the Gray Matters perk you'll receive 25% less damage when hit in the head.
translation: 保护重要的部位。灰质贵perk使你头部被击中的所受伤害减少25%.

original: Your familiarity with alien technology gives you better control over their weapons, increasing their damage output by 10%.
translation: 对外星科技的熟悉使你能更好掌控其武器，它们的伤害输出提升10%。

original: Your business prowess gives you discounts wherever you shop.
translation: 无你在哪里购物，你的商业实力都能为你提供折扣。

original: Fawkes' love for heavy weapons is infectious. With Fawkes in your party, weapon strength requirements are 1 point lower for you.
translation: 福克斯对重型武器的热爱很有感染力。当福克斯在你的队伍中，你的武器力量要求会降低1点。

original: Star Paladin Cross is a seasoned veteran of power armor use and can show you a thing or two about how to use it at it's maximum potential. While Star Paladin Cross is in your party, you have +1 Endurance and +20 carry weight when you are wearing power armor.
translation: 星骑士克罗丝是一位使用动力护甲的百战老兵，可以向你展示如何发挥它的最大潜力。当星骑士克罗丝在你的队伍中，你穿动力护甲时获得+1耐力和+20负重。

original: Butch is a gang member at heart, and gangs have to have multiple members wearing the same colors. While Butch is in your party, you both gain +5% damage if you are both using the same weapon, and +5% DR if he is using the same armor as you, with an extra +5% if they are Tunnel Snake outfits.
translation: 布奇本质上是一个帮派成员，而帮派必须有多个穿一样衣服的成员。当布奇在你的队伍中，你们使用相同武器时都会获得+5%伤害，使用相同的护甲时都会获得+5% DR，如果都穿隧道蛇服装则再获得+5% DR。

original: Eulogy was right about her. When you've had a hard day on the road and are ready to call it a night, she will make sure you wake up *very* well rested. With Clover in your party, the Well Rested bonus will grant you an additional 15% XP and +1 Luck!
translation: 悼词对她的评价恰如其分。当你在旅途中度过了辛苦的一天并准备好好休息时，她会确保你醒来时得到*非常*充分的休息。如果 三叶草在你的队伍中，充分休息加成将为你提供额外的15% XP 和+1运气！

original: Charon's tenacity and his unwavering loyalty to the holder of his contract are remarkable. You've learned something from his tenacity: For each 10% health you are below maximum, you gain 1 DT.
translation: 卡戎对他合同的持有者拥有非凡的坚韧和坚定不移的忠诚。你从他的坚韧中学到了一些东西：你的生命每低于最大值10%，就会获得1 DT。

original: Butch is a gang member at heart, and gangs have to have multiple members wearing the same colors. While Butch is in your party, you both gain +5% damage if you are both using the same weapon, and +5% DR if he is using the same armor as you, with an extra +5% if they are Tunnel Snake outfits.
translation: 布奇本质上是一个帮派成员，而帮派必须有多个穿一样衣服的成员。当布奇在你的队伍中，你们使用相同武器时都会获得+5%伤害，使用相同的护甲时都会获得+5% DR，如果都穿隧道蛇服装则再获得+5% DR。
